CREATE TABLE marketplace_resources (
    kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Associated Kind resource ID', 
    resource_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Resource type: agent or skill' DEFAULT '', 
    install_count INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Cumulative first-time marketplace installations' DEFAULT '0', 
    published_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Initial marketplace publication time' DEFAULT now(), 
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Marketplace resource update time' DEFAULT now(), 
    PRIMARY KEY (kind_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX idx_marketplace_resources_type_updated ON marketplace_resources (resource_type, updated_at, kind_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_marketplace_resources_type_installs ON marketplace_resources (resource_type, install_count, updated_at, kind_id)

INSERT INTO marketplace_resources (kind_id, resource_type, install_count, published_at, updated_at) SELECT kinds.id, CASE WHEN (kinds.kind = 'Team') THEN 'agent' ELSE 'skill' END AS anon_1, CASE WHEN (kinds.kind = 'Team') THEN coalesce(anon_3.install_count, 0) ELSE coalesce(anon_4.install_count, 0) END AS anon_2, kinds.created_at, kinds.updated_at 
FROM kinds LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT resource_members.resource_id AS kind_id, count(*) AS install_count 
FROM resource_members 
WHERE resource_members.resource_type = 'Team' AND resource_members.status = 'approved' GROUP BY resource_members.resource_id) AS anon_3 ON anon_3.kind_id = kinds.id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CAST(json_unquote(json_extract(skill_bindings.json, '$.spec.skillRef.skillId')) AS SIGNED INTEGER) AS kind_id, count(*) AS install_count 
FROM kinds AS skill_bindings 
WHERE skill_bindings.kind = 'SkillBinding' AND skill_bindings.is_active IS true GROUP BY CAST(json_unquote(json_extract(skill_bindings.json, '$.spec.skillRef.skillId')) AS SIGNED INTEGER)) AS anon_4 ON anon_4.kind_id = kinds.id 
WHERE kinds.user_id != 0 AND kinds.kind IN ('Team', 'Skill') AND kinds.is_active IS true AND json_unquote(json_extract(kinds.json, '$.spec.capability.visibility')) = 'public' AND json_unquote(json_extract(kinds.json, '$.spec.capability.publishStatus')) = 'published'
